newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan electronics up on high-dividend hopes.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan electronics up on high-dividend hopes.

text.p: Taiwan's electronics shares rose in early Tuesday trade on expectations that companies in this sector would declare higher dividends from March, brokers said.
After 45 minutes, electronics shares rose 1.69 percent while the overall index was up 0.58 percent.
Austek surged by the daily seven percent limit to T$347, and Inventec Corp was also limit up to T$223.

"Entering the dividend-issue season starting from March, these electronics which have high dividend potentials would continue to attract bargain hunting," said Nomura Securities analyst Amy Huang. Analysts had predicted Asustek's earnings per share for 1997 to exceed T$30 and Inventec to surpass T$20.
